issues.description: The problem statement asks for municipalities with more than 100.000 (one hundred thousand) male and female inhabitants, but the solution query uses a threshold of 10000 (ten thousand). This numeric mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students and cause automated checks to reject correct student queries that follow the problem text.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Either change the solution query to use > 100000 (e.g. WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000) to match the problem statement, or adjust the problem text to require 10.000 if the intent was ten thousand. Ensure template, problem text, and solution use the same value.
